source_system: Owner packet workbench, first-packet decision board, and one local pilot record set
source_owner: Local record owner and service owner, confirmed before SRC2+ transfer

field_mappings.owners: map record_owner_role, service_owner_role, and reviewer roles after minimization; do not publish personal contact details
field_mappings.use_case: map selected service purpose, intended users, explicit non-use cases, and required human owner from the selected service record and owner packet
field_mappings.data_map: map only high-level source system, aggregate logs, retention posture, and fallback route; raw learner traces stay out
field_mappings.authority: map actual_action_ceiling, durable writes, queue effects, record effects, and rollback route before any evidence claim
field_mappings.memory: map only maximum memory class and inspection/correction route; protected support facts remain local
field_mappings.evidence_claims: map one aggregate learning, task, workload, or false-action signal only with method note, context, limits, expiry, and public claim to remove
field_mappings.construct_and_proof: map required unaided segment, answer-giving or false-action stop count, and proof bundle only as aggregate or teacher-reviewed summary
field_mappings.accessibility_and_protected_support: map no-penalty fallback, abstract protected-route owner, support handoff count, and non-misuse boundary without support facts
field_mappings.security: map security class, red-team date if public-safe, stop trigger, and owner action; raw payloads, prompts, keys, and exploit details stay local
field_mappings.workload: map workload_minutes_by_phase with preparation, review, correction, and escalation separated
field_mappings.decision: map first-review decision and first-packet decision-board outcome, including lifecycle and public-summary effects, to decision.status, decision.lifecycle_decision, and public_summary.claim_limit
field_mappings.publication_and_adapters: map source record status, source confidence, sector adapter, redaction profile, and normalization notes after source truth review
field_mappings.public_summary: map only owner-approved public notice or summary text after public-claim lexicon and redaction review

do_not_import_fields: raw learner prompts, chats, essays, work traces, recordings, screenshots, names, IDs, or private messages
diagnosis, disability, accommodation, language-access, hardship, immigration, discipline, counselling, family, or protected support facts
security exploit strings, system prompts, API keys, credentials, tool-call payloads, or unsafe red-team artifacts
small subgroup metrics or protected cuts that could identify a learner or support route
vendor marketing copy or effectiveness claims not independently reviewed by the local owner
full LMS, roster, vendor, or merged data-lake exports sent because they are easy to export
redaction_before_commit: complete the owner packet workbench before schema mapping
remove direct learner identifiers, raw traces, private narratives, screenshots, and support facts
replace security payloads with risk-class labels, stop triggers, and owner actions
aggregate or suppress small-cell metrics before sharing
separate public-summary text from protected local review notes
trim decision-neutral export residue and record it as TRIM or LOCAL-ONLY
commit only the decision-board outcome and abstract effects, not protected facts, raw learner traces, or raw security payloads
stop_conditions: protected facts would enter a public example or ordinary service field
authority cannot be bounded, reviewed, or rolled back
evidence cannot be separated by family, method, context, and expiry
source owner cannot confirm source class, date range, or field meanings
owner can only provide a broad export, raw learner trace packet, or unsafe security payload
first-packet decision board is missing, blank, or cannot identify an authority/evidence/construct/public/lifecycle effect
decision_delta_questions: Which fields changed action authority, human handoff, rollback, or no-penalty route?
Which fields changed evidence grade, method, expiry, or public claim family?
Which fields changed construct, cognitive-effort, or unaided-proof posture?
Which protected or security facts stayed local and how are they represented abstractly?
Which received fields were decision-neutral and should be trimmed or not requested again?
Does FT-0181 remain live, fall back to AIEDU-SR-003, or proceed to staged SRC2+ review?
Did the first-packet decision board produce a before/after authority, evidence, construct, public-summary, protected/security, and lifecycle decision?
